translationRepairs: On the day wuzi, Prince of Anding Jun Boyu died.
On the day wuzi, Boyu, Prince of Anding Commandery died.
安定郡王 is Prince of Anding Commandery; 伯栩 is his name.
On the day gengchen, Bo Fu was enfeoffed as Prince of Anding.
On the day gengchen, Bozhu was enfeoffed as Prince of Anding.
On the day wuwu, Cheng Song was stripped of rank and demoted to deputy military training commissioner of Guo Prefecture, with compulsory residence at Bin Prefecture.
On the day wuwu, Cheng Song was stripped of rank and demoted to vice military training commissioner of Guo Prefecture, with compulsory residence at Bin Prefecture.
On the day guichou, Liu Can of the Ministry of Personnel and others were charged to review court and provincial reports on huizi policy and submit their findings.
On the day guichou, Liu Yue of the Ministry of Personnel and others were charged to review court and provincial reports on huizi policy and submit their findings.
劉爚 is read Liu Yue.
On the day jihai, Cao Yueyue, vice-commissioner of Hunan transport, was appointed prefect of Tanzhou and charged with suppressing stockade outlaws.
On the day jihai, Cao Yanyue, vice-commissioner of Hunan transport, was appointed prefect of Tanzhou and charged with suppressing stockade outlaws.
Cao Yueyue, prefect of Tanzhou, fought the outlaws again and was likewise defeated, and their power grew stronger still.
Cao Yanyue, prefect of Tanzhou, fought the outlaws again and was likewise defeated, and their power grew stronger still.
In the sixth month, on the day dinghai, Yu Song was sent to the Jin court with birthday felicitations, but turmoil in the Jin state kept him from reaching court and he turned back.
In the sixth month, on the day dinghai, Yu Rong was sent to the Jin court with birthday felicitations, but turmoil in the Jin state kept him from reaching court and he turned back.
余嶸 is read Yu Rong.

In the twelfth month, on the day xinsi, Gentlemen for Discussion Zhang Zeng was punished for agitating over the succession: he was removed from office and exiled under surveillance to Xiang Prefecture.
In the twelfth month, on the day xinsi, Gentleman for Discussion Zhang Zi was punished for agitating over the succession: he was removed from office and exiled under surveillance to Xiang Prefecture.
張鎡 is read Zhang Zi; title singular.
In the first month of spring in the sixth year (1213), on the day gengshen, Yuwen Shao died.
In the first month of spring in the sixth year (1213), on the day gengshen, Yuwen Shaojie died.
宇文紹節 is Yuwen Shaojie.
On the day gengxu, Li Qi was sent to the Jin court with New Year's greetings; he too failed to arrive and turned back.
On the day gengxu, Li Kan was sent to the Jin court with New Year's greetings; he too failed to arrive and turned back.
李𡌴 is Li Kan, as elsewhere in the chapter.

On the first day of the eleventh month, the day xinyou, Nie Zishu was sent to the Jin court with New Year's greetings; Vice Minister Liu Yao and Imperial University students jointly petitioned against the mission, but the court did not respond.

On the first day of the eleventh month, the day xinyou, Nie Zishu was sent to the Jin court with New Year's greetings; Vice Minister Liu Yue and Imperial University students jointly petitioned against the mission, but the court did not respond.
劉爚 is read Liu Yue.
That year the Li Prefecture tribesman Chu Bu surrendered for the first time.
That year the Li Prefecture tribesman Xubu surrendered for the first time.
畜卜 is read Xubu, as earlier in the chapter.
In spring of the eighth year of Jiading (1215), on the day xinwei in the first month, Shi Yu was appointed to succeed to the title Prince of Xiu.
In spring of the eighth year of Jiading (1215), on the day xinwei in the first month, Shiyu was appointed to succeed to the title Prince of Xiu.
師禹 is a single given name.
On the day guimao, Prince of Anding Boqiu died.
On the day guimao, Prince of Anding Bozhu died.
